GPT-5.3-Codex: contamination policy is a vocabulary gap — safe-point language exists in newer addenda but contamination classification, restore-before-reuse, and lane quarantine semantics are mostly absent
Gap: package-based worktrees are not yet defined as a canonical concept; per-node worktrees are the current model but are the wrong shape for scale
Gap: provider/model settings are not yet defined at node, work package, feature seam, work package overseer, and delegated-subagent levels — this gap must be filled before schemas can be finalized
Not yet defined: how node retry memory, attempt handoff artifacts, reusable learning records, and worker handoff packets map into the seglog/redb/Tantivy stack — this gap must be resolved
safe-point vs restore-point vs rollback vocabulary is NOT normalized across runtime, policy, interview, and worktree docs — one canonical vocabulary must be chosen
startup recovery remains split across policy, executor, and storage docs with no single owner deciding how interrupted attempts become stale_historical vs rehydrated vs startup_recovered
give startup recovery, backoff, counter ceilings, DAE/jail lifecycle, account-switch strategy invalidation, and wizard blocked-escalation semantics explicit homes in the policy/run-mode/gate docs
